The following events took place in '''82 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This year was known as '''Year 47''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] passes the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and becomes a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. He takes [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] takes [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] as his Padawan learner.

==Births==
*47BrS:8:11&mdash;[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="I84">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>
*[[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]]<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref> on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]
*[[Doman Beruss (Illodian)|Doman Beruss]] on [[Illodia]]
*[[Kal Skirata|Falin Mattran]]<ref name="Kal Skirata age">Kal Skirata is said to be "about sixty standard years" in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', which takes place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Thus, Skirata must have been born around [[82 BBY/Legends|82 BBY]].</ref> on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
